note: Tennessee State Parks, 13 mi north of Memphis in the Mississippi River bottomland forest. Dogwood Ridge Campground: paved or concrete, level, fully shaded sites on three branches off Dogwood Ridge road, two bathhouses, playground, community fire pit and pavilion; three primitive group tent sites on a gravel road nearby. One Way Road past the campground is closed for erosion (2026). --Claude
